name: kosha
description: Kosha: personal finance tracker built on the MERN stack with a Gemini-powered copilot

scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.test: npm run test -w shared && npm run test -w server && npm run test -w client
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:coverage -w server && npm run test:coverage -w client
